weighting: none — this step compares raw simulated fields, no ensemble is weighted

arms.legacy: initial_quality assigned raw (superseded), tolerance 0.01; its output is what the pre-correction cache stored and the log quoted as mg/L
arms.corrected: current configuration: mg/L -> kg/m^3 on the way in, kg/m^3 -> mg/L on the way out, plus the CHOSEN strict tolerance 1e-05 mg/L (written verbatim to the .inp; EPANET's default is 0.01 mg/L)
arms.units_only: units corrected but tolerance left at the 0.01 mg/L default — the units fixed and the numerical resolution coarsened 1000x, kept as the counterfactual

tolerance_note: EPANET's TOLERANCE is written to the .inp verbatim and read in the file's quality unit, so both numbers are mg/L. 1e-5 mg/L is 1000x stricter than EPANET's 0.01 default: a chosen setting that holds the tolerance/source ratio of the superseded run fixed, NOT a unit conversion
verdict: the correction is a relabelling: the reported field is unchanged to floating point
coefficients_note: k_b (1/time) and k_w (length/time) carry no mass unit and were never affected; step13 arms 1-3 verify them against an analytic solution and step13 arm 4 pins the concentration unit against WNTR's own to_si/from_si
